title: Dino Dino Jungle in 1:35.69 ~ Mario Kart Tour Time Trial
description:
Kinda messy looking (particularly lap 1), but this is the fastest known run as of October 26th, 2019. Probably not for long after #top-scores over on Discord sees this strat and does it better lol

The dino boost trick after the run is something I've done by accident 4 times. It's only ever happened on lap 2 for me, but if someone could somehow exploit it twice, it may be faster than my no-2nd-glider strat.

My best lap 1 split is 47.62
